name: init
description: Create the initial Ceph default configuration and set up symlinks. Idempotent on re-call: if a [global] section already exists in ceph.conf, the existing fsid / auth / pool defaults are preserved and most parameters are silently ignored.

params.name: cluster-network
params.description: Declare a separate cluster network, OSDs will route heartbeat, object replication and recovery traffic over it

params.name: disable_cephx
params.description:
Disable cephx authentication.

WARNING: cephx is a security feature protecting against man-in-the-middle attacks. Only consider disabling cephx if your network is private!

params.name: min_size
params.description: Minimum number of available replicas per object to allow I/O

params.name: network
params.description: Use specific network for all ceph related traffic

params.name: pg_bits
params.description:
Placement group bits, used to specify the default number of placement groups.

Depreacted. This setting was deprecated in recent Ceph versions.

params.name: size
params.description: Targeted number of replicas per object
